## Accepted unresolved Torelli-restriction partial, attempt 1/5

Problem 11000312 / AMR-109-0312, rank 1258. Morita Problem 4.5 asks whether rational degree-four restriction from Out(F_4) to GL(4,Z)-invariant cohomology of IOut_4 is an isomorphism, with nonzero canonical higher torsion generating the target.

The complete report and audit preserve Theorems A–D: the exact unstable LHS image/kernel reduction; full algebraic-dual coinvariant homology criterion; orientation reversal killing the standard Bestvina–Bux–Margalit top torus cycles and their ambient conjugates; and identification of unrestricted Borel-primitive ambiguity with the real restriction image. All symbolic proofs, qualifications, and credited primary inputs remain included.

The torsion-permanence proposition remains conditional on FI, which has not been independently established at rank four. Nonzero restriction, surjectivity, and nonzero canonical higher torsion are not proved. The full target remains unresolved; stable or conditional results and independent torus families do not close the gap. No novelty certification is claimed.

This AI-assisted, unrefereed edition claims no historical novelty, priority, current-openness certification, external human peer review, journal acceptance or formal proof-assistant certification. Source retrieval and inspection are historical observations. Edition preparation claims no new scholarly retrieval, PDF rehash, source inspection or literature search.
